groups.description: Live travel-and-expense and spend-management products this domain is modeled on — useful to see how the employee, travel, and finance surfaces are positioned in practice.

links.title: Rydoo — smart expense management
links.relevance: The primary reference for the modeled domain — combines expense capture, travel expense, cards, approvals, and finance integrations into one control loop the finance leader (cg1-p1) buys into.

links.title: SAP Concur — travel, expense & invoice
links.relevance: The enterprise incumbent benchmark; shows the deep policy controls and ERP integration the finance/controller persona (cg1-p1) compares against.

links.title: Navan — business travel and expense
links.relevance: The modern full-stack challenger that unifies booking, card, and automation — grounds the travel-program owner persona's (cg2-p1) booking-plus-policy expectations.

groups.description: Background on the business-travel and corporate-spend industry, its scale, and structural trends.

links.title: GBTA — Global Business Travel Association
links.relevance: Primary-source business-travel market outlook and benchmarks that frame why the travel manager (cg2-p1) cares about in-policy booking and supplier adoption.

links.title: TravelPerk + Yokoy — integrated travel and expense
links.relevance: Documents the category's consolidation of travel and expense into one platform — the structural shift the whole domain model is built around.

groups.description: Rules and controls that govern reimbursement, VAT recovery, and audit-ready spend records.

links.title: IRS — standard mileage rates
links.relevance: The U.S. mileage and per-diem rules the platform must encode so the finance controller (cg1-p1) keeps reimbursements compliant and audit-ready.

links.title: European Commission — VAT rules and rates
links.relevance: The cross-border VAT framework behind tax-friendly expense workflows and VAT recovery that the multinational finance persona (cg1-p1) depends on.

groups.description: Capture, approval, and submission experiences aimed at the employees and managers who actually generate expenses.

links.title: Rydoo — expense management software
links.relevance: The mobile receipt-capture, mileage, and submission surface that drives the traveling employee persona's (cg3-p1) low-friction submission jobs.

links.title: Expensify — expense and receipt capture
links.relevance: An employee-led capture and reimbursement benchmark — useful for comparing how the line-manager and traveler personas (cg3-p1) submit and approve spend.
